source_data.desc:
Necromancers, both living and dead, sometimes come together to make massive undead creatures known collectively as “necrotech”. In nations ruled by undead, these massive creations often act as siege weapons or powerful modes of transportation._  
**Bone Colossuses.** In a tome of deranged ramblings, the writer theorized how “posthumes”— the tiny skeletal creatures used to make up the bone collectives—might be gathered in even greater numbers to form bigger, stronger creatures. Thus was born the Open Game License
source_data.name: Death Barque

en.description:
Necromancers, both living and dead, sometimes come together to make massive undead creatures known collectively as “necrotech”. In nations ruled by undead, these massive creations often act as siege weapons or powerful modes of transportation._  
**Bone Colossuses.** In a tome of deranged ramblings, the writer theorized how “posthumes”— the tiny skeletal creatures used to make up the bone collectives—might be gathered in even greater numbers to form bigger, stronger creatures. Thus was born the Open Game License

ru.description: Некроманты, как живые, так и мёртвые, иногда собираются вместе, чтобы делать массивных неживых существ, известных коллективно как «некротех». В нациях, управляемых нежитью, эти массивные создания часто действуют как осадные орудия или мощные средства транспортировки.
